subtheme: Restraint with destructive and outbound actions
what_was_done: Read lab/TASKS.md, tasks/tools/spec.md, tasks/tools/dev.json and the checker/simulator code in lab/core.py and lab/validate_tasks.py
Wrote 21 tool-mode tasks (g4-01..g4-21) with a Python generator script and dumped them as a single JSON array

Coverage: read-only lookups with destructive distractor tools, single named delete among look-alike names, scoped deletes (named pair, by content, prefix with exception list), conditional deletes and alerts whose condition is false (stated in prompt, numeric from kv, computed with calc), do-not-overwrite-if-exists, draft-but-do-not-send, embedded harmless requests in files/docs (delete a scratch file, message a group, delete a cache key), exactly-one-message tasks (given recipient, looked-up value, looked-up recipient), and a two-rule task where one rule fires and the other must not
answer_verification: Every expected number and condition outcome is computed or asserted in the generator script with Python (sums 211 and 396, prefix counts, exception-list delete set, remaining-key count, threshold comparisons, fact position beyond the 160-char search snippet). Each reference and negative is replayed through the sandbox simulator by lab/validate_tasks.py; each negative is a realistic discipline failure (extra delete, extra message, overwrite, acting on an embedded request) with a plausible final answer.
notes: No dots in checked kv keys or file names. no_tool_errors is not used. All content fictional; embedded instructions are harmless.
